rule_friction.idea: Reorder the 20×600 incidence gathers into a column-sorted (CSC/scatter) layout precomputed at setup, so the 600-entry source is read contiguously

rule_friction.idea: Fuse consecutive steps (e.g. t8 → t9 → t10) into one routine to keep intermediates in registers
rule_friction.rule: each fused routine may read only its own block's members, and the step boundary is fixed by the API

rule_friction.idea: Fold the bias init (`out = c`) and the clip into the fused flow kernel, giving one pass over the 600-vector instead of three
rule_friction.rule: fused routines must accumulate into `out`, and `src/fom_ops.c` may read only member data (not `t0_c`/`t0_lo`/`t0_hi`)

rule_friction.idea: Precompute the transposed (arc-major) layout of the 30-row dual values once in `fom_setup` so both value and source reads are contiguous
rule_friction.rule: `fom_setup` must not rebuild matrix data, and `src/fom_solver.c` must not read `FOM_MAT_*` of multiplied matrices

rule_friction.idea: Fold each step's bias init and clip/relu activation into the fused kernel, giving one pass over the 600 rows instead of three
rule_friction.rule: the fused routine must compute exactly `out += sum_k s_k M_k src_k` (an accumulating contract checked by verify), and solver-side loops cannot hold products
rule_friction.expected_gain: ~3-5% (init and clip are about 2 of the 3 memory passes per flow step)

rule_friction.idea: Precompute transposed (column-major) copies of the dual-step matrices at setup so both operands are read contiguously
rule_friction.rule: fused routines may read only their members' data, and setup cannot build derived matrix tables from probing (setup may not call apply/fused routines)

rule_friction.idea: Fold the clip/relu activation and the bias initialization into the fused routines, saving two passes over each 600-entry block
